The '''Pinurquia system''' was located in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Pinurquian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Insider89" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pinurquia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
